display_long_description:
Flappy VR: MULTIPLAYER IS HERE
YOU ARE THE BIRD. NOW, BRING YOUR SQUAD!

The world’s most addictive challenge is back, and this time, you aren’t flying alone. Flappy VR transforms your room into a high-stakes skyway where your physical movements control your flight. No buttons, no shortcuts—just pure arm-flapping action!

Experience the rush of soaring through giant obstacles in a fully immersive 360-degree environment. Whether you are looking for a quick cardio session or a competitive showdown, the sky is yours to conquer.

KEY FEATURES:
PHYSICAL WING-FLAPPING: Use your Meta Quest controllers to physically flap your wings. It’s intuitive, immersive, and a great way to break a sweat!

EPIC MULTIPLAYER BATTLES: Don't just fly—race! Engage in intense 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, or 4v4 team battles. Prefer a casual flight? Join a group of up to 5 friends and see who survives the longest.

GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS: Every pipe cleared brings you closer to the top. Track your rank against players worldwide and prove you are the ultimate flyer.

SILKY SMOOTH PERFORMANCE: Optimized for 90/120Hz on Quest 2, 3, and Pro to ensure a comfortable, nausea-free experience even in the heat of battle.

TEAM STRATEGY: Coordinate with your teammates in squad modes to dominate the skies and outlast the opposition.

The original challenge was hard. Doing it with a squad is legendary.

Are you ready to feel the burn and claim the #1 spot? 
Download Flappy VR today and take flight!
